catalog_crosswalk.statement_and_boundary: B iff □∃E Eval(E), where Eval sends current truths to top and current falsehoods to bottom. A single necessarily correct E instead yields Extensionality.
Actuality < ND + Actuality < Gallin Comprehension < C5 + Actuality < B < Extensionality, with explicit separators. The inequalities concern the displayed equivalent evaluator principles.

Gallin Comprehension gives a unique globally bivalent current evaluator and unique globally two-valued representatives of current extensions. It preserves quantifiers for each current predicate; the stronger universally boxed commutation remains unproved.

Functional Choice iff Actuality plus right inverses for actual surjections between relational types. Boxed Functional Choice iff boxed Actuality plus strong right inverses. Both the source and target of the split maps are relational types; quantifier placement is essential.

Plenitude iff Actuality plus left inverses for injections between relational types. Strong left inverses for actual injections characterize C5; strong left invertibility of a particular such map corresponds to its necessary injectivity.

At any one relational type, operation-valued uniform Persistent, Weak Persistent, or Weak Inextensible Comprehension each characterizes Actuality. No analogous equivalence for full uniform IC is asserted.

Actuality alone interprets current extensional relational Henkin HOL on all current individuals. Relational Choice transfers, as does the quantified Infinity axiom exactly. Truth in the slice is the actual atom, which can disappear later.
Below the actual atom, every represented family has a join given by a supported existential union. Local atoms are world-and-tuple haecceities. This does not give ambient BC.
Under Gallin Comprehension, the Actuality slice and the globally two-valued core are canonically isomorphic as current extensional structures. This does not identify their future domains.
ND + Rigid Power gives extensional relational HOL over any nonempty rigid individual domain. The all-current-individual and Choice refinements retain their explicit extra assumptions.
ND_t + IC_(τt) implies WRP_τ. In particular, ND + IC implies full Weakly Rigid Power. Neither IC nor ND is silently boxed.
Tame Rigidity iff rigid relations are closed under all existing represented joins. Weakly rigid relations already have that closure in C.
ND corresponds to binary intersection/difference closure of rigid relations; complement closure has the stronger BF/C5 requirements specified in the note. These are type-sensitive exact definitions.
Relational Choice + BC implies Transversal Choice. The sharpened local choice instance selects a point of type σ from a property of type σt. Represented well-ordered chain joins suffice.
Relational Choice_(τ,τ) plus represented chain completeness, even only the relevant internally well-ordered chains, implies BC_τ.
Relational Choice + matching countable Boolean completeness + matching internal ccc implies BC. The same guarded progression gives the sharper transversal corollary.
An internally countable Boolean type with the matching countable completeness is internally finite. No external-finiteness conclusion is intended.
Strong Leibniz + Rigid Comprehension implies necessary Strong Leibniz and necessary BF at relational types. Including bottom in the rigid world cover repairs the future-cut argument.
The existing model has ND + full BC + ¬IC_et + ¬RigidComprehension_et at E, but ¬BC_et at O. The earlier even-haecceity family was not admitted.
Over ND + BC, IC, Rigid Comprehension, Tame Rigidity and WRP are equivalent additional assumptions. The corrected old/new model shows they need not hold.
Full TR and boxed BF, together with boxed RP_et, do not imply WRP_et. This does not settle the all-type TR + RP conjecture.
Full Gallin constructions give F with both quantified Infinity axioms. The model and the exact distinction between arithmetic infinity and domain infinity are explicit.

Unique realization of all individual profiles is realized by suitable full Gallin models. Unrestricted realization at a relational input type is impossible by a diagonal; supported-core variants avoid it.

B plus both Infinity axioms and profile realization at every finite supported core rank can hold while Functional Choice fails. Ordinary e-core Choice can also coexist with failure of every nontrivial ambient unary FC instance.
